title: Initialize DMP Codex and First Decision Record
decision: Establish DMP by publishing the Codex v0.1, a minimal decision record specification, and a first canonical record.
context: DMP begins as a protocol for decision memory; implementation is intentionally out of scope to preserve clarity and responsibility.
rationale: Starting with meaning and non-editable memory ensures decisions remain causally accountable over time.
consequences: The project is oriented around memory before tooling, enabling future systems to build on stable principles.
alternatives: Begin with implementation details and define the protocol later
Wait for a complete tiering system before recording decisions
